boards.school_name: North Carolina State University at Raleigh
boards.title: Your First Weekend at North Carolina State University at Raleigh, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence of named NC State landmarks and student spaces for getting oriented across Main and Centennial campuses.

cards.title: Start at Talley Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the second-floor Information Desk to get oriented, then choose a lounge or terrace for a short reset before continuing your campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for campus information, seating and student-life resources.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State identifies Talley Student Union as the hub of student life and says its second-floor Information Desk assists visitors.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Centers page for current building hours; the Information Desk is on Talley’s second floor.

cards.title: Meet the wolves at Wolf Plaza
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Near Talley Student Union
cards.notes: Pause by the three bronze wolf sculptures, take a group photo, then use the nearby tunnel as the next waypoint on your Main Campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor plaza with three bronze wolf sculptures near Talley.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Student Centers says Wolf Plaza features a trio of bronze wolf sculptures by artist Michael Stutz and sits near the Free Expression Tunnel.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Spaces | NC State Student Centers
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; continue on to the nearby Free Expression Tunnel.

cards.title: Walk through the Free Expression Tunnel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • North–Central Campus connection
cards.notes: Walk through to see the current layers of public paint. If you plan to add anything, review university guidance and bring only permitted materials.
cards.short_summary: A designated graffiti-friendly underpass linking north and central campuses.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Wellness describes the Free Expression Tunnel as a heavily trafficked underpass connecting north and central campuses and a graffiti-friendly zone.
cards.access_notes: This is an active pedestrian underpass; be considerate of people passing through.

cards.title: Cross University Plaza, the Brickyard
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • North Campus
cards.notes: Use the open plaza as a landmark for your first route across North Campus, and look for posted student-organization tables or campus events.
cards.short_summary: The Brickyard is University Plaza, a North Campus gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Parents and Families Services identifies the Brickyard’s official name as University Plaza and describes it as a gathering spot for students, organizations, club fairs and events.
cards.source_title: Learn the Lingo | NC State Parents and Families Services
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; event tables and programming vary by day.

cards.title: Stop at the Memorial Belltower
cards.subtitle: Friday near sunset • Henry Square
cards.notes: Take in the memorial’s plaques and architecture from Henry Square. Return another evening if the university announces a red-light celebration.
cards.short_summary: A campus memorial and longstanding rallying point for the Wolfpack community.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State says the Memorial Belltower has been a university symbol and memorial since its 1937 completion, as well as a rallying point for the campus community.
cards.source_title: Belltower Celebrations | Office of the Chancellor
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial area; lighting occasions are announced by the university.

cards.title: Take a breather on the Court of North Carolina
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • North Campus
cards.notes: Choose a bench or patch of grass for coffee, a book or conversation, then identify the older academic buildings that border this large green space.
cards.short_summary: A major Main Campus lawn framed by historic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Student Centers identifies the Court of North Carolina as the largest green space on Main Campus.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Spaces | NC State Student Centers
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; scheduled events may affect portions of the lawn.

cards.title: Find your D. H. Hill Jr. Library nook
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • Main Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the Learning Commons and stacks, then save a study-room option for later once you know the library’s current access and reservation rules.
cards.short_summary: A Main Campus library with study rooms, creative technology and a popular-reading lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State University Libraries says Hill Library has reservable study rooms, making and digital-media spaces, and a Popular Reading Lounge in the first-floor Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: D. H. Hill Jr. Library | NC State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s live hours and any access requirements before entering or reserving a room.

cards.title: See Reynolds Coliseum from Talley’s edge
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Central Campus
cards.notes: Walk by the exterior and read the setting as part of campus history; check the official athletics calendar separately before planning around an event.
cards.short_summary: A Hallowed Place that remains home to NC State women’s basketball.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State News identifies Reynolds Coliseum as a Hallowed Place and says it continues to serve as the home of the university’s women’s basketball team.
cards.source_title: Discover Our Colorful Campus | NC State News
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is a reliable stop; event and interior access depend on the current schedule.

cards.title: Head to Hunt Library on Centennial Campus
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon • Centennial Campus
cards.notes: Explore the public-facing library spaces and its bookBot setting, then pick one collaborative or quiet area to bookmark for a future study session.
cards.short_summary: Centennial Campus’s social and academic hub, with collaborative and quiet study options.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State University Libraries describes Hunt Library as Centennial Campus’s social and academic hub, with bookBot, collaborative spaces and quiet places to study.
cards.source_title: James B. Hunt Jr. Library | NC State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s live hours and current access guidance before making the trip to Centennial Campus.

cards.title: Close the weekend at The Oval
cards.subtitle: Sunday late afternoon • Centennial Campus
cards.notes: Finish with a slow lap around the grassy space, noting the Hunt Library and engineering buildings that frame this designated Hallowed Place.
cards.short_summary: A Centennial Campus green space surrounded by engineering buildings and Hunt Library.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State says The Oval is a grassy Centennial Campus space surrounded by four engineering buildings and Hunt Library, and was named the university’s 10th Hallowed Place.
cards.source_title: The Oval Becomes NC State's Newest Hallowed Place | NC State News
cards.access_notes: Outdoor green space on Centennial Campus.
